## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 11 jul 2026 - 11 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _A Sprz_, 11 jul 2026, 3/5: "The app is beautiful. Love the customization. I got a lifetime subscription and am happy to not have to pay annually. Could you please consider adding the ability to increase the font size? It would be perfect then."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 17 ago 2026 - 29 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Anissa Garcia_, 29 ago 2026, 1/5: "I love this app. I believe there is a bug. I am unable to share habits with others and consistently get “Failed to modify some records” every time. The person I am trying to share habits with also gets the same notification. Please fix! 🫶🏼"
            2. _sianadele_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "Downloaded this because I’ve seen so many people talking about it. It started off well but not every time I open the app it freezes and I can’t click anything!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
